title: footballLLM
summary: A Python project (single-commit, no README) containing a baselines.py module that defines wrapper functions to import and configure tabular synthesizers, likely for comparison against a football-related LLM/data-generation approach. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and SingleTableMetadata (with version-compatible fallbacks to the older sdv.tabular API) to build baseline synthetic-data generators.
evidence: src/baselines.py:15-45 defines _import_ctgan/_import_tvae/_build_metadata using sdv.single_table CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata.detect_from_dataframe
needs: No README or call sites shown confirming these baseline functions are actually invoked elsewhere in the project; domain/industry of the football LLM work is unclear from available evidence.
